notes: The start-up screen now shows your organisation's name under your logo instead of IT-Vault. The app-icon colour picker is gone -- none of those three tiles was your logo; the home-screen shortcut, which does carry it, is still there. Every message is signed off the same way: the emailed signed-acknowledgement PDF, the sign-in code, password resets, ticket mail and the SMTP check all carry your name and live links, and so do Telegram and Slack alerts.
